summary: A model call can fail or hang. You add a timeout, a fallback to a second model that records which model answered, a clear 503 when everything fails, and learn what a safe cache needs (a key with the role in it, and a written limit). The models are labelled stand-ins: one works, one is down, one is too slow.
goal: Make one call fall back to a second model.

items.text: Add reliability.py and fallback_demo.py and match the five scenarios
Change the timeout of the slow scenario and predict who answers and how long the user waits
Make the first model raise a ValueError and say whether the fallback should hide it
Wire it in: the writer, the 503 and the model name in the metrics
Play the Fallback Check game to the end and see your score
